dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おに〜ちゃん♪」
dialogues.en: "Bro~♪"
dialogues.text: "Bro~♪"

dialogues.jp: ぴょこたん、と柱の影からさくらが顔を出す。
dialogues.en: From behind a pillar, Sakura's face peeped out at me.
dialogues.text: From behind a pillar, Sakura's face peeped out at me.

dialogues.jp: 「よ、待ち伏せか？」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, an ambush?"
dialogues.text: "Whoa, an ambush?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「半分そうだよ。でも、ボクはここでみんなが
　帰る姿を見てるのだ！」
dialogues.en: "Kinda. I'm also watching people go home!"
dialogues.text: "Kinda. I'm also watching people go home!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「帰る姿？」
dialogues.en: "People going home?"
dialogues.text: "People going home?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「この校門を出るとね、みんなの表情が変わっ
　て面白いの」
dialogues.en:
"People's expressions as they pass through this gate are
really cool."
dialogues.text:
"People's expressions as they pass through this gate are
really cool."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「表情？」
dialogues.en: "Expressions?"
dialogues.text: "Expressions?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「帰りのホームルームが終わったときもそうだ
　けど、やっぱり区切りとしてはココなんだよ
　ね」
dialogues.en:
"When going home after the end of homeroom, this is the
place that marks the end of the school day."
dialogues.text:
"When going home after the end of homeroom, this is the
place that marks the end of the school day."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「嬉しそうっていうか、顔がやさしくなるのが
　好き♪　特に今日はテストが終わったから良
　かったよ」
dialogues.en:
"I like the happy look on people's faces as they pass by♪
Even better, since tests ended today."
dialogues.text:
"I like the happy look on people's faces as they pass by♪
Even better, since tests ended today."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「良かったよ、良かったよ〜！」
dialogues.en: "It's over, it's over~!"
dialogues.text: "It's over, it's over~!"

dialogues.jp: わたわた、と手を振ってさくらが笑う。
dialogues.en:
She excitedly waved her hand around, laughing the entire
time.
dialogues.text:
She excitedly waved her hand around, laughing the entire
time.

dialogues.jp: 「そんな興奮することもないだろうが……」
dialogues.en: "That's nothing to be THAT excited over..."
dialogues.text: "That's nothing to be THAT excited over..."

dialogues.jp: 俺も立ち止まって校門を振り返る。
dialogues.en: I stopped at the school gates and looked around.
dialogues.text: I stopped at the school gates and looked around.

dialogues.jp:
特に意識したことはなかったが、まぁ、ここか
ら外に出ると肩の力が抜けるのは確かか。
dialogues.en:
I don't normally notice it, but I suppose when I walk out
these gates, it does fee like a weight is lifted off my
shoulders...
dialogues.text:
I don't normally notice it, but I suppose when I walk out
these gates, it does fee like a weight is lifted off my
shoulders...

dialogues.jp: しかし、見ていて楽しいか？
dialogues.en: But, being happy from watching that?
dialogues.text: But, being happy from watching that?

dialogues.jp: あらためて変なヤツだ。
dialogues.en: Weird as always, this girl.
dialogues.text: Weird as always, this girl.

dialogues.jp: 「……一緒に帰るか？」
dialogues.en: "...Want to go home together?"
dialogues.text: "...Want to go home together?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あー、Ｓｏｒｒｙ。クラスのみんなとテスト
　が終わったらカラオケに行こうって約束して
　て。もうすぐ集合時間なんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Ah~, sorry. My class organized a karaoke outing when the
tests were over, and it's almost time to meet up."
dialogues.text:
"Ah~, sorry. My class organized a karaoke outing when the
tests were over, and it's almost time to meet up."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前は遊び組か」
dialogues.en: "So, you're from the celebration group."
dialogues.text: "So, you're from the celebration group."

dialogues.jp:
テストが終了したところで、だいたいの学生が
遊びに行くか、睡眠を求めるかの２組に分かれ
る。
dialogues.en:
At the end of exams, there're two groups of people. The ones
who celebrate, and the ones who go to sleep.
dialogues.text:
At the end of exams, there're two groups of people. The ones
who celebrate, and the ones who go to sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんは寝る派だよね」
dialogues.en: "And you're part of the sleepyheads."
dialogues.text: "And you're part of the sleepyheads."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「笑顔で断定するなよ……そうだけどさ」
dialogues.en: "Don't just smile and decide that... although you're right."
dialogues.text: "Don't just smile and decide that... although you're right."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「おーい、芳乃さ〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Yoshino-san!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Yoshino-san!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　王子さまが呼んでる？」
dialogues.en: "Unya? Is my prince calling me?"
dialogues.text: "Unya? Is my prince calling me?"

dialogues.jp:
現れたのは王子さま……とも呼べなくもない工
藤だった。
dialogues.en: And thusly, the prince appeared... or rather, Kudou did.
dialogues.text: And thusly, the prince appeared... or rather, Kudou did.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やほー、くっぴー♪」
dialogues.en: "Hey there-, Kuu-pi~"
dialogues.text: "Hey there-, Kuu-pi~"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いたいた。みんな集まったから、そろそ
　ろ行こうって」
dialogues.en:
"Hah, here you were. Everyone's gathered and getting ready
to leave."
dialogues.text:
"Hah, here you were. Everyone's gathered and getting ready
to leave."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「よお、モテモテだな、工藤」
dialogues.en: "Yo, popular aren't you, Kudou?"
dialogues.text: "Yo, popular aren't you, Kudou?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「おいおい、朝倉。そんなコドモみたいなこと
　言わないでくれよ」
dialogues.en: "Oy oy, Asakura. Don't say childish things like that."
dialogues.text: "Oy oy, Asakura. Don't say childish things like that."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「コドモはこいつだけでじゅーぶん」
dialogues.en: "I'm not the childish one here."
dialogues.text: "I'm not the childish one here."

dialogues.jp:
ちょうど手頃な場所にいたさくらの頭をぽんぽ
んと叩く。
dialogues.en: I patted Sakura on the head with my hand.
dialogues.text: I patted Sakura on the head with my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゅにゅ……絶対ボクにケンカ売ってるで
　しょ、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Unyunyu... I'm not going to argue with you today, bro."
dialogues.text: "Unyunyu... I'm not going to argue with you today, bro."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でもお前がカラオケのお誘いに乗るってのも、
　なにか意外な感じがするな」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't think you'd be invited to a class outing though,
Kudou."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't think you'd be invited to a class outing though,
Kudou."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ははは……せっかく芳乃さんのクラスの子た
　ちから誘われたんだ。むげに断れないさ」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha... Yoshino-san's class took all the trouble to
invite me, so I couldn't say no."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha... Yoshino-san's class took all the trouble to
invite me, so I couldn't say no."

dialogues.jp: 人気者はツライね、どーも。
dialogues.en: I'm sooorrry, being popular must be sooooo hard.
dialogues.text: I'm sooorrry, being popular must be sooooo hard.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「とはいえ、どうもあのカラオケの騒がしい雰
　囲気は、あまり積極的に好きにはなれないん
　だけれどね」
dialogues.en:
"I don't usually like karaoke since it's so noisy, but I'd
have to grin and bear it."
dialogues.text:
"I don't usually like karaoke since it's so noisy, but I'd
have to grin and bear it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃにゃ？　みんなでカラオケ、たのしーよ！
　歌って騒いで浮世の憂さを晴らす、日本人の
　お祭り好きのＤＮＡが呼んでいるよ〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"Nyanya? Singing karaoke with everyone is fun! It's in every
Japanese person's DNA to noisily sing all your troubles
away~♪"
dialogues.text:
"Nyanya? Singing karaoke with everyone is fun! It's in every
Japanese person's DNA to noisily sing all your troubles
away~♪"

dialogues.jp: そうだな……。
dialogues.en: I wonder...
dialogues.text: I wonder...

dialogues.jp: ◆待ち伏せさくら◆
dialogues.en: ◆How's Karaoke?◆
dialogues.text: ◆How's Karaoke?◆

dialogues.jp:
テストも終わり、意気揚揚と校門を出たところ
でさくらに出会った。
dialogues.en:
After the end of the exams, I triumphantly left through the
school gates and met Sakura.
dialogues.text:
After the end of the exams, I triumphantly left through the
school gates and met Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
晴れ晴れとした皆の顔を見るのが楽しい――な
んて、可愛いことを言う。
dialogues.en:
She felt happy watching the cheerful faces pile out of
school-- how cute.
dialogues.text:
She felt happy watching the cheerful faces pile out of
school-- how cute.

dialogues.jp:
そこへ工藤が現れた。なんでもさくらのクラス
の子達とカラオケに行くらしい。
dialogues.en:
Then Kudou popped up. He was joining Sakura's class in a
karaoke outing.
dialogues.text:
Then Kudou popped up. He was joining Sakura's class in a
karaoke outing.

dialogues.jp:
工藤はカラオケの騒がしさが好きになれないと
いい、さくらはみんなで騒ぐから楽しいという。
俺としては──。
dialogues.en:
Kudou found karaoke too noisy for his liking, while Sakura
enjoyed singing away with everyone.
dialogues.text:
Kudou found karaoke too noisy for his liking, while Sakura
enjoyed singing away with everyone.
